headline: Market closed for weekend; Reliance Brands narrows losses while Chalet Hotels outlines ₹3,500 crore capex plan.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Market is closed today, Sunday, for the regular weekend holiday.
Reliance Brands reported FY26 revenue growth of 3.8% to ₹3,390.9 crore with narrowed losses.
Chalet Hotels announced a ₹3,500 crore capital expenditure plan over three years.
Mahindra Last Mile Mobility is evaluating an IPO within 18 months to fund future expansion.
whatHappening: India's oil and gas import bill surged 60% in October driven by higher Brent prices.
Congress raised concerns over SEBI proposals regarding foreign funds with opaque offshore structures.
Aluminium product manufacturers requested zero import duty on raw metal ahead of the Union Budget.
EV brand E-Went plans to test sodium-ion batteries starting December for mass market deployment.
summary: Markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 23 November. Key updates include Reliance Brands narrowing its FY26 loss to ₹137 crore and Chalet Hotels detailing a ₹3,500 crore capex plan. Mahindra Last Mile Mobility is eyeing an IPO within 18 months.
